questions.q: A patient with hyperlipidemia is advised to use therapeutic lifestyle changes (TLC). Which fat substitution is most effective for lowering LDL cholesterol?
options: Replacing saturated fats with mono- and polyunsaturated fats (e.g., olive oil, avocado).
questions.explain: Replacing saturated fats with unsaturated fats lowers LDL. Coconut oil is high in saturated fat. Refined carbs can increase triglycerides.
